content.text: Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey, left, drives against Detroit Pistons forward Paul Reed during the first half of an NBA Cup basketball game Friday, Nov. 14, 2025, in Detroit. (AP Photo/Ryan Sun)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Joey Aliberti | JAliberti@syracuse.comThe Philadelphia 76ers host the Detroit Pistons Saturday at 7 p.m. ET. Detroit is 3-0 against Philadelphia this season. The Pistons will look to complete the season sweep while the 76ers need a win to stay in the top six of the Eastern Conference. Pistons vs. 76ers will air on NBA TV, and streams live on FuboTV (free trial).What: NBA regular seasonWho: Detroit Pistons (56-21) vs. Philadelphia (42-34)When: Saturday, April 4, 2026Where: Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, PennsylvaniaTime: 7:00 p.m. ET TV: NBA TV (out-of-market), NBC Sports Philadelphia, FanDuel Sports Network DetroitLive stream: DIRECTV (free trial), FuboTV (free trial)What to know about Pistons vs. 76ersHere’s a recent basketball story from the Associated Press:DETROIT (AP) — All-Star guard Cade Cunningham of the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons will be out at least another week in his recovery from a collapsed left lung.The Pistons gave an update Thursday before beating Minnesota 113-108, saying Cunningham will be re-evaluated in one week. He is working to return to the court being supervised by doctors and Detroit’s medical and performance staff.Detroit announced Cunningham’s injury March 19, two days after he was hurt in a game at Washington.Cunningham is averaging 24.5 points and 9.9 assists for the Pistons. Only eight players in NBA history have finished a season averaging that many points and assists, and Cunningham would be the first to do so in a Detroit uniform.The Pistons have clinched the Central Division and improved to 7-2 since Cunningham’s lung injury, shooting to hold onto top seeding in the Eastern Conference playoffs to perhaps improve their chances to advance for the first time since 2008.Cunningham has played 61 games and after being out at least a week, he won’t reach the 65-game minimum to be eligible for NBA postseason awards.Where to watch Mets vs. Dodgers today: MLB free live streamWhere to watch Warriors vs. Clippers today: NBA Play-In free live streamWhere to watch LA Galaxy vs. Toluca today: Concacaf soccer free live streamWhere to watch Stars vs. Sabres today: NHL free live streamWhere to watch Naples vs. Orlando City SC: US Open Cup free streamJoey Aliberti is a Sports Commerce Reporter for syracuse.com | The Post-Standard, covering sports, TV, streaming and tickets for teams including the Buffalo Bills, New York Jets, New York Giants, New York...
